notes.title: Randy plush available for next 4 days (+ other news!)
notes.content:
First of all, let me apologize for writing this so late! I intended to write this after the last update, but completely forgot! My bad! I'll start with the most pressing announcement first!

[h1][u][b]RANDY'S BACK [/b][/u][i](for 4 more days.)[/i][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/3c843013f1cecf5f222136b06abc8f6ddc52f785.png[/img]
[b][i]Back by popular demand! [/i][/b]It's a re-do of the very first Dialtown plushie! I've been posting about it on my other socials, but figured I'd mention it here quickly before the campaign ends, on the off-chance anyone's just following [i]here[/i] (and nowhere else!)

[previewyoutube=2ibRB7nZB84;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/randy-jade-2-0-plush][u][b]He'll be gone for YEARS in 4 days time, so if you'd like to get one, click this link!!![/b][/u][/url][/h1]
[i][h3](He also comes with a free sticker if we can get over the 1k sales mark, which is pretty neat!)[/h3][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/fa89721397e402ab12075c9daaf8359660287210.png[/img]
On another note, as I've mentioned on Tumblr/Twitter, I added a new encounter to Roger's route featuring Rebecca, the plant's security guard! The script has been extended by just over [b]3,000[/b] words of dialogue [i]and [/i]there's a brand new scene in the evil half of Roger's route with roughly [b]50[/b] new voice acted Roger lines!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/294761b265472221742782861610220fa1dfe8a7.png[/img]
The new scene's quite cute and has a good amount of new dialogue, now included for everyone in the Roger's route DLC! With the new scene out of the way, I'm now working on the [b]NEXT[/b] Dialtown DLC, which involves Gingi going to the funfair with both Randy [b]AND[/b] Oliver, which is by far the most popular DLC pitch I received from fans of Dialtown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/6de537098e6bdbf5c23ac8c0ece311643f8061c2.png[/img]
As the image shows, the route's scenes/endings have been outlined and full-production of the route is now underway! The DLC's still early days as of yet, but ending slides, music, new 3d models and new art is being worked on for the route right now! With the new update to Roger's route out, I'm now putting a script together based on the drafts I have on paper + completing assets for the route. Rather than showing off unfinished stuff, I'll post screenshots in the next devlog, which won't be [i]too [/i]far away! :)

With that, I'd like to thank you all for your continued support! There's some cool DT stuff slated both for this year and the next and I'm very excited for what's to come!

notes.title: ROGER'S ROUTE DLC IS OUT!!!
notes.content:
[i]I'll keep this one short and sweet.[/i]

[u][i][h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170530/Dialtown_Rogers_Route_DLC/]It's here, folks!!![/url][/b][/h2][/i][/u]

[previewyoutube=4zaydREBfGE;full][/previewyoutube]
[i][h2]Roger's route is now here and boy is this one a doozy!!! Provided you take your time and explore the dialogue paths, it's over 6 hours long![/h2][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/68abd811f9790d6eb0226aa0cb9a93cdd61a64d6.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Roger has a lot to say, with over a THOUSAND voiced dialogue lines ranging from confessions of his innermost turmoil to lashing out at you over centipede-related aggression! Really get to know Roger via a multitude of voice acted scenes where Roger talks about his life, responsibilities, worries and hopes for the future!
[*]The route has 8 endings, ranging from guzzling cough syrup in a circus tent to getting thrown in jail for fraud! The possibilities are endless! (And by endless, I mean there's exactly eight of them.)
[*]Run a scam on Roger and trick him into delivering a pyramid scheme crypto rug-pull to his workers (you can destroy the dude's life and WORSE!)
[*]A new Original Soundtrack by Nathan Hanover, featuring 14 tracks not heard in Dialtown's basegame, from remixes/reprises of existing tracks to completely NEW tracks!
[*]Choices that matter! The choices you make will impact the lives of the citizens of Dialtown! Be responsible! (Or don't. I can't really do anything either way. Like, c'mon. I WISH I was that powerful...)
[*]Control the pace of conversations with skip points all over the DLC. With a script of over 94,000 words, you can spend HOURS talking to Rogers about baboons, centipedes, pyramid schemes and more!
[*]Spend time with most (if not all) of your favourite Dialtown characters! This route has a shocking amount of character cameos! Ticket Jerry, Randy, Oliver + Karen Dunn fans rejoice!
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170530/Dialtown_Rogers_Route_DLC/][h1][u][b][u]YOU CAN GET IT ON ITS PAGE RIGHT NOW BY CLICKING HERE![/u][/b][/u][/h1][/url]
[u][b](Note, Steam doesn't automatically install DLC if you have it open when you make the purchase, so shut down Steam after buying it and relaunch it from scratch to play the DLC right away! Sorry, that's a Steam quirk that affects other games too!) You can start the DLC once installed by visiting Downtown + talking with people on the street![/b][/u]

Oh, also, the Mingus + pins campaigns were just extended today, so if you haven't gotten either yet, you've got a little bit longer to get them!!! Available for just a limited time now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/bf7f347e2c532cb4675efc300086db98633d0e98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/d521753e76ea0882c6fc82b7719b1b1bc08b4810.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/a732b8b69e03f24764508b3256661a49dff1eecf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/4961e887e49143da22afc0044b5835fefc57830f.png[/img]
[url=https://www.makeship.com/shop/creator/directdoggo][h2][i][u][b]YOU CAN GET BOTH ON MY MAKESHIP CREATOR PAGE JUST FOR THE NEXT WEEK OR SO!!![/b][/u][/i][/h2][/url]

That's it for this devlog! [i]Hope you guys enjoy the DLC![/i] It was a real labour of love and there's plenty of nods in it to my older work + the DT basegame, [b][u]with over 20 cameo appearances!!![/u][/b] [i][b]Thanks, everyone!!![/b][/i]

notes.title: Mingus + New Pinset Launch + ROGER Route News!!!
notes.content:
Hey, guys! It's been a lil while, huh? I'll start with the Roger's route news first!
[h1][i]ROGER, ROGER![/i][/h1]
[b]I'm on schedule for an October release![/b] Excitingly, [b]80%[/b] of the route has now been implemented, including 4 of the 8 endings. Currently the whole evil half of the route is now playable! I just retrofitted one of the ending scenes with voice acting the other night!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/0026beef9a82f104e930d7d6000ea0f67dada2aa.png[/img]
As always, here's The Chart™, showing a more or less scene-by-scene summary of the route! [b]Everything in green is playable and complete, minus a final round of playtesting/bugfixing.[/b] While the orange part [i]looks[/i] quite large, it only makes up about 20% of the script! Based on the current rate of progress, I should finish the next ending within the next few days and soon after that, make a bee-line for the other 3 endings! As an extra little bonus, here's some more voice acted footage, this time from the evil half of the route:

[previewyoutube=wRplvW1JswU;full][/previewyoutube]
The evil route involves Gingi running a scam on Roger and seeing how far it can push Roger's gullibility! It's a little bit experimental (it's not quite like any of the other routes), and contains some cool visual stuff, a lil 3d work, a sick art sequence and some great new music! The entire route also contains some subtle callbacks to my previous work which eagle-eyed players may pick up on!

In my [i]NEXT [/i]devlog, I will formally [b]announce the DLC's release date! [/b]I won't announce the specific day I have in my head yet (in case there's any unexpected delays), but I'd like to get the route out during the first half of October if possible! :)

[h1][i]It's Mingling Time!!![/i][/h1]
[h3][i][b]She's heeeere![/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/d521753e76ea0882c6fc82b7719b1b1bc08b4810.png[/img]
I've been real excited to reveal this one! There was quite a lot of back and forth behind the scenes regarding the fur and boy, did she turn out beautifully! Here's a few pics I took of the plush!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/4961e887e49143da22afc0044b5835fefc57830f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/79ff6aa2dc62ef0fa71eee70fa17078d9d478ad7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/a732b8b69e03f24764508b3256661a49dff1eecf.png[/img]
Also, I've heard your demands and now, [i][b]there's Ticket Jerry merch![/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/0e5a7202a8f1d2fd18c5d355ac5d6c244768c2f9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/bf7f347e2c532cb4675efc300086db98633d0e98.png[/img]
[i][b]Yep, Karen, Ticket Jerry and Bigfoot! [/b][/i]By far the 3 most popular pin requests from fans, available as a set. Easily three of Dialtown's more respectable residents.

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/mayor-mingus-plushie][h2][i][b]You can buy the Mingus plush via this hyperlink![/b][/i][/h2][/url]
[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/dialtown-quality-residents-pinset][h2][i][b]Aaaand you can buy the pins via THIS hyperlink![/b][/i][/h2][/url]
Anyway, thanks for reading and for your continued support! Next devlog will be the announcement of [i]exactly [/i]when Roger's route is releasing next month! [i]Catch you on the flipside!!![/i]

notes.title: New Roger DLC teaser video!
notes.content:
Hey, guys! Dogman, here! Just wanted to write a quick devlog to show off a lil more of Roger's route (and after that, mention the merch that's coming out for Dialtown's 2-year anniversary! So, without further ado, [i]let's get into it![/i]

[h1]Show us the haps, Dogman:[/h1]
Over the last couple of months, I've been working on assets (backgrounds, character sprites), and implementing the [b]very first scenes[/b] in the route, with finalized assets! I've also moved further ahead with the script. [i]There's [b]new voice lines[/b] too! [/i]Oh, and there's also been [b]new ending slides[/b] finished behind the scenes as well. [i]Funky![/i]

Since I'm quite a bit behind my targeted release date, thanks to having to move in December, I thought I'd show off a few minutes of footage from Roger's route, [strike]partly to show that I'm still working on it[/strike], featuring the redux of Roger + Peter's introduction scene in Dialtown, complete with new assets, fonts and plenty of new dialogue! Work on the route has been slow (but steady) lately!

[previewyoutube=Utcwh6hNVyA;full](INSERT VIDEO HERE, DON'T FORGET, DOGMAN, SO HELP ME GOD)[/previewyoutube]
[h1]New merch, you say?[/h1]
Yep! There's gonna be more merch dropping for Dialtown's 2-year anniversary (which is on the 14th of February)! Specifically, a [b][i]Phonegingi plush[/i][/b] and a trio of [i][b]Dialtown enamel pins[/b][/i], which even come with new Dialtown art. [i][b]Wowzers![/b][/i]

I'll resist showing them off JUST yet, but the Makeship pages for each'll be going live the day after this goes up, and a few days after that, I'll be begin teasing the new designs on my [url=https://twitter.com/DirectDoggo]Twitter[/url]/[url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/directdogman]Tumblr[/url] accounts! When the anniversary comes (on the 14th), I'll make a new devlog!

Thanks for reading and for y'alls patience waiting for the new DLC! I'm doing my [i]very[/i] best to make sure that the wait's worth it! [i]Thanks!!![/i]

notes.title: DIALTOWN RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.content:
I can't believe it's been like 4 months. Apologies, things have been moving so fast that I've been perpetually putting off the next devlog by 'maybe a few more weeks'. With that, I'll cut the shit and present my big news.
[b][h1]Dialtown is now finished.[/h1][/b]
[h2][b][i]Yes, it's true![/i][/b] [/h2]
I'm working on polish, bugfixing and finishing up the cut content shown on the extras menu right now, but the actual game, and its five routes, are all working/fully implemented.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/eb532403a66d3844303fba996b6e1775bd41202e.png[/img]
[h3]Yeah, it's all done. [i]Every route, every ending, [b]every scene.[/b][/i][/h3]

[b][i][h1]iOS and Mac support![/h1][/i][/b]
Yeah, this is something I'm very excited about. Dialtown is also coming to Mac + iOS on launch. A friend is helping me port the game to those two devices and while we're tweaking some things still, unless mr Apple-man (Stephen Job) is an asshole and specifically stops us (bastard), we SHOULD be able to get the iOS/Mac ports working for the main release, allowing for a [u][i][b]Windows, Android, iOS + MacOS simultaneous launch![/b][/i][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/fd2e66cf4300370098017f12a1c77dddca5ac054.png[/img]

Yes. A game about dating telephones coming to most modern kinds of phones. [i][b]The irony's wonderful.[/b][/i]

[b][i][h1]Dialtown's release trailer![/h1][/i][/b]
Here, a special re-cut of my Valentine's Trailer, complete with release date, platforms listed + Callum Crown design reveal :)
[previewyoutube=Xuxu40YnV-0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][i][u][b]Dialtown: Phone Dating Sim releases on Valentines Day (February 14th), 2022.[/b][/u][/i][/h3]

Coming soon on Window PC, MacOS, Android and iOS.

Thanks for reading, I'll keep y'all updated with future stuff! Thanks, have a truly doggly night!

Yours houndly,
Dogman

notes.title: DIALTOWN DEVLOG (12/09/21)
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Howdy, folks, it's been a while, huh?[/b][/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/90c75785a6f5f197c0ceef1102319172a0ae1451.png[/img]

First of all, sorry for the wait, I'm aware it's been a couple of months. This is honestly a weird point in development because at this point, every new scene I have, even still images, contain [i]spoilers.[/i] This makes it hard to show what I'm actually working on [i]off.[/i] But, I've been hard at work! Progress has been going well, and I'm excited to show you a few things :) Gonna make this a [i]BIG [/i]devlog because you guys deserve it!

[i][b][h1]Meet Mayor Mingus! [/h1][/b][/i]
[previewyoutube=Xidl0UHoYFs;full][/previewyoutube]

Been a whiiile since I revealed a new character, so I thought I'd introduce everyone to Mayor Mingus Crown, Dialtown's corrupt and ruthless leader. This lil scene is from one of the routes. (Also, thanks to my cat Salvage for modeling for her! It's the head. It's HIS head.)

[h1][i][b]Demo is playable on Android phones![/b][/i][/h1]
Yeah, yeah, I know, I know. I had an older build on mobile previously. But, the new build has fullscreen support, NEW ui with bigger buttons, bugfixes + more touch friendly controls, etc! A lot of work went into it, it's STILL experimental... 

[h3][url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Dialtown/495033]But if you wanna try it out, you can get the demo on mobile [i]RIIIGHT over here![/i][/url][/h3]

Getting the full game on the google playstore would also [i](hopefully)[/i] allow Chromebooks to play Dialtown, since that can access the Play Store! Woohoo. [b]I also updated the PC version with some shared code improvements[/b], namely to UI. It's ALSO [b][i]super experimental,[/i][/b] so lemme know how it all works!

[h1][b]Total progress:[/b][/h1]
[i]Alright, drum-roll please...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/92773672fed267055413d3f0ccd6c1669f55e890.png[/img]
Yep! Progress has been good! While the jump from the last devlog mightn't look all that impressive, believe me, a lot of work has gone into the next scenes, so really, that yellow should be a light shade of green. They're (mostly) asset complete, but a decent bit of work is needed to complete them. If you've played the demo and seen the standards I set for the early routes, you'll understand why. Things [i]do [/i]get picked up a notch.

Then, I have to finish the extras menu, and then really teesssssstttt the whole game out, lots of bugfixing, tweaking and testing. But, it's doable. A few of my developer friends said they're willing to give me a hand when the time comes. :)

[i][b]I'm still on track for a 2021 release![/b][/i] Only reason I'd delay it is a release conflict or if a massive IRL calamity hit me. I have a realistic release date in my head that I'm aiming for. If all goes well, next devlog'll confirm what that date is! Otherwise, that's it for this devlog. I wanna thank you all for dreaming and hooting and hollering with me and such, and of course, for reading this devlog. [i]Hope y'all are doin' well![/i]

[h2][i][b]Stay Houndly!

-Dogman[/b][/i][/h2]

notes.title: Devlog (06/07/21)
notes.content:
Hey, y'all! Long time no speaky, huh?

Apologies for not writing this sooner, simply put: I wanted to wait 'til I had something important enough to show y'all, something to warrant me writing one of these. This stage of development is funny in that since the end of the game is practically just a string of scenes that are RIFE with spoilers, I can't really show off much directly.

But, I DO have a lil to talk about! So, talk I shall. :)
[h1][i][b]ROUTE 5 PROGRESS:[/b][/i][/h1]
The final route is coming along nicely. The first half or so of the route is fully finished. Since there are recurring locations exclusive to this route, and all of them have appeared already thus far, the second half of the route WILL be easier to develop than the first! Hurrah! Here's a few screens from the route:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/c8714fdcfb5120c4221cca46cfb097fff4f45fa6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/3bd645d6dc817f141907ecffaf09b3272568144a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/177f56a11c8f78f148370e4468fbc368e75f4691.png[/img]

I'd love to show more off, but the further you play into the route, the more spoilery it gets. Also, in other news: [b]A pal of mine tested the first half of the final route.[/b] He found a few bugs (which I have thoroughly squished), gave a lot of positive feedback (promising!) and some really good criticism/suggestions on things to change/modify (thankfully, most of which I can do quickly enough). So, yeah, first half of route five shaped up nicely!

[h1][i][b]Total progress![/b][/i][/h1]
This wouldn't be a Dialtown devlog with The Chort. So, lemme whip it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/49f3155a11ab09660141239c19ed1dea4148cb99.png[/img]
You know the deal by this point. The flowchart shows most of the significant scenes/events in each route, with [b]green stuff being fully done content[/b]. [b]Yellow = finished script/some assets[/b], code WIP. There was also purple for placeholder assets and red for completely unfinished material, but those have been removed fully from the chart. :)

Progress has been great lately, basically. [i][b]24/26 endings done, whew! [/b][/i]Not been getting much sleep, but hey, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TnlPtaPxXfc][u][i][b][h3]That's Life![/h3][/b][/i][/u][/url] 
[expand type=showmore][i](Legal notice: Frank Sinatra, Frank Sinatra Enterprises, LLC (yeah, that's the actual name of the company, not kidding) nor the Universal Music Group condone Dialtown in any shape or form. In fact, if Frank Sinatra was alive, I'm sure he'd personally detest Dialtown with a passion and send goons to my house to beat me up or make me watch Shark Tale (now available on Blu-ray!) or something. But, he's dead, so like... Who's gonna pay for the goons NOW, Frankie, HUH? Haha, SUCKER.)[/i][/expand]
[h1][i][b]Latest patch:[/b][/i][/h1]
I'm also mentioning this as an aside, [b]I uploaded a new demo patch[/b] late last month, just to fix some bugs and junk. [b]I also improved some assets[/b], redoing Billy/Gabby's poses from scratch and adding many more poses to their pose-pools. Here's a direct comparison so you can see what I mean. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/015b2e13eab79ad3f9dcad4332bf7cdcb05b376f.png[/img]

Yep! I added head turn variants for poses that made sense and added new body poses. [i]Huzzah.[/i] [b]Oh, and there's a new song on the OST.[/b] It plays during Oliver's route, and you can find it in the demo portion of his route right now! Here's a Streamable link if you wanna listen to it right now! [i](Temp link, will expire 3 months from now!)[/i]

[h2][u][url=https://streamable.com/1hn31e][i][u][b]Musac Heore.[/b][/u][/i][/url][/u][/h2]

A lot of the code in the new update is experimental and may break anything and everything. But, so far, doesn't seem to have broken much, if anything. [i]If it does, lemme know![/i]

[h1][i][b]Let's address the elephant in the room.[/b][/i][/h1]
[b][u][i][h3]Release plans.[/h3][/i][/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/78a57b6f3ebf10bea92f2028c5509d2d61895fce.png[/img]
Alright, alright, [b]I thought the game was gonna release in Spring.[/b] But, I decided not to push for a Spring release (as the end of Spring approached), because while I could've just about made it, I [i]really don't[/i] wanna rush the final release. I felt it was better to take the time to go back and improve some of the earlier assets, touch up the game just so the quality is somewhat consistent.

To err on the side of caution, I won't say what month DT is planning to release on in case there's set backs, but [u][b]Dialtown releasing during the second half of 2021 is guaranteed.[/b][/u] If I don't, fuck it, another video of me as a horse drinking hard liquor straight from the bottle. I'll even use a different Sinatra song (read legal notice above.) (But, no, I [i]won't[/i] fail.)

This stage of development is always the hardest for me, to be honest. When you work on something for 2 and a half years (WOW,) it can be hard to see how good your game even is. [i]Is it good? Who knows, [strike]it's just my weird mutant child who I kiiinda wanna ditch at the grocery store, y'know?[/strike][/i] But, I can say one thing for sure, after receiving feedback from my testers: [h3][i][b]If you enjoyed the demo/Randy's route, then the best is yet to come![/b][/i][/h3]

[i]Thanks for reading and dreaming with me and junk![/i] As always, I'm a fucking mutt. [i]Goodnight, everyone![/i]

notes.title: Demo hit 1k players & Oliver's route now done!
notes.content:
Howdy, folks, Dogman, 'ere. Thought I'd update you all since it's been about a month since my last devlog!
[h1]Oliver's route is now implemented![/h1]
[i][b]Yes, folks, it's true. Oliver's route is now implemented, all 5 endings working/in-game![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/736c2b2fab50775168826d3f7a24d53dc2ff2abb.png[/img]
Here's the ole reliable roadmap. As you can see, [b]3/5 routes ARE now finished.[/b] In terms of endings, that's [b]19 out of 25[/b] endings. I have a good few months of work ahead of me, getting the final two routes scripted, shot, assets produced, (art, music and voice acting is still to be done), and finally, working and in-game. [i][b]But, progress has been good![/b][/i]

[h1]1k demo players! (and a comment on Dialtown's overall public process.)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34842794/939a20fdcf0943d5db77374eb87db5df86262611.png[/img]
Well, I'll keep this short, but over 1,000 people have played (and I hope enjoyed) Dialtown's demo! This is a really weird number for me, because you can look at it in two ways. In a cynical light: DT's demo only made in two months what Dayshift at Freddy's (my last series) makes in 2.5 days! 

That's... [i]not so encouraging.[/i] In a way, just a teensy bit heartbreaking, actually, as is the fact that only ONE youtuber that's covered DSaF has actually bothered to play Dialtown's demo, with most not even acknowledging my messages at all. (Which I believe to be a major reason for these poorer figures.)

What [i]IS[/i] encouraging, though, is the outpouring of fanart, the active discord community appearing for the game, as well as the dedication of the fans that Dialtown DOES have. Phonecord, for instance, Dialtown's discord server [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/SMEDN7M][i][b](CLICK THIS TEXT IF YOU'D LIKE TO JOIN.)[/b][/i][/url] has over 400 members and is incredibly active. 

Usually, when a big release happens, there's a jolt... followed by a decline, until something big carries the release to a larger base of people. Dialtown's player numbers have remained [b][i]CONSISTENT[/i][/b], despite only minor updates occurring to the demo, which is an incredibly optimistic showing of just how much its fans are trying to [strike]force the game down people's throats like a regurgitating momma bird [/strike]help convert potential players to the Dialtown family, which is fantastic to see.

That truly gives me the motivation to finish the game, knowing that not everyone is going to walk away just because I don't do FNaF stuff anymore. Really. I know Dialtown can blow my previous work out of the water in many ways, and I will do everything in my power to make it the best game it can be. 

[h1]Do [i]YOU [/i]wanna make history?[/h1]
One small final thing, btw: If anyone wants, I have a [url=https://www.patreon.com/directdogman]Patreon [/url]now, since I realized that I lacked a real tip-jar. I've got a few ranked pledging tiers, if anyone's interested in any of these things:[list]
[*] Unique role in my discord server!
[*] Have your name in the DT credits!
[*] Have your VERY OWN name easter egg in-game!
[*] Access to a special channel in my discord server where you see bimonthly video teasers!
[/list]
Any amount is appreciated, ofc, but I figure those tiers might be desirable to some :) [url=https://www.patreon.com/directdogman]If you're interested, you can find that, here. [/url]Thanks, and see y'all in the next devlog!
